title: Doctor's bag
description: Dr. Emmy's doctor's bag for the desk in her flat: a chunky Kenney-style Gladstone bag, dark red-brown leather with a rounded top split by a brass clasp, a carry handle on two brass mounts, a white patch with a red cross on the front, short feet. Static prop, no clips. Sized for the desk top (the game draws the Furniture Kit about twice its size).
checks: FRONT tile: a wide dark red-brown bag, wider than tall, with a rounded top
FRONT tile: a white square patch with a red cross sits on the front face, below the clasp line
FRONT tile: a brass band runs along the bag where the rounded top meets the body
3/4 tile: a dark grip stands on top on two short posts with brass mounts
LEFT tile: the bag's bottom sits on the grid line, nothing floats
